en:
I don't give two squirts of piss about the
student council! It's got nothing to do with me!

If those turds wanna roll downhill together,
that's fine by me!

<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Miu for a while?
Even though it might not be safe to ask...

Huh!? Get your diarrhea-lookin' face
outta here!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time taking Miu's verbal abuse,
but she calmed down eventually.

<CLT=cltMIND>I somehow ended up growing
a little closer to Miu...
